en: But there was no doubt that Gael, the president of the glass company, was indeed a kappa who made me feel deeply at ease.
u.src: 但是，毫无疑问，玻璃公司的老板嘎尔的确是一只让我倍感亲切的河童。

en: Gael and I often went together to the club he belonged to, and spent one pleasant evening after another there.
u.src: 我和嘎尔常常一起去他参加的俱乐部，度过一个又一个欢乐的夜晚。

ja: つは、このクラブのほうが
en: One reason was that this club felt much more relaxed and comfortable than the Superman Club I had attended with Tok.
u.src: 其中一个原因是在这个俱乐部里比在托喀参加的超人俱乐部要更为轻松自在。

en: And although Gael's words were not as profound as those of the philosopher Mag, they let me glimpse an entirely new world, a far broader world.
u.src: 而且嘎尔的话虽然不如哲学家马咯的话那么深奥，却让我窥见了一个全新的世界——一个更为广阔的世界。

en: Gael would always stir his coffee with a solid gold spoon while cheerfully talking about all sorts of things.
u.src: 嘎尔总是一边用纯金的羹匙搅拌咖啡，一边愉快的地谈天论地。

en: One evening, when the fog was very thick, I sat across from Gael and listened to him chatter, with a vase full of winter roses between us.
u.src: 有一个晚上雾下的很大，隔着一个插满冬蔷薇的花瓶，我坐在对面听嘎尔漫谈。

en: I remember that it was a Secession-style room, and everything in it, including the table and chairs, was white with thin gold trim.
u.src: 我记得那是一个分离派风格的房间，整个房间包括桌椅都是白色镶细金边的。

en: Gael was even more self-satisfied than usual, smiling broadly as he talked about the ruling party, the Quorax Party cabinet.
u.src: 嘎尔比平时还要志得意满，笑容满面地谈着执政党——Quorax党内阁。

en: Quorax was only an interjection with no real meaning, and could only be translated as something like oh dear.
u.src: “喀拉克斯”只是个没有实际意义的感叹词，只能翻译成“哎呀”。

en: In short, it was a political party that claimed it would always put first the welfare of all kappa.
u.src: 总而言之，这是声称着永远优先为“全体河童谋福利”的政党。

en: The leader of the Karax Party is the famous politician Lope.
u.src: “喀拉克斯党的领袖是著名政治家啰培。

en: Did Bismarck once say, 'Honesty is the best diplomacy'?
u.src: 俾斯麦以前说过‘诚实是最好的外交’吗？

en: However, Lope applied honesty to domestic politics as well..."
u.src: 然而啰培把诚实也运用到内政上面了……”
“可是啰培的演讲……”

en: Now, listen to what I have to tell you.
u.src: “喏，你听我跟你说。

en: That, of course, is complete nonsense.
u.src: 那当然是一派胡扯。

en: Since everyone knows he is talking nonsense, it is no different from telling the truth.
u.src: 既然大家都知道他在胡扯，那么就和说真话没什么区别了。

en: Your belief that everything it says is false is merely your own personal prejudice.
u.src: 你认为它说的都是假话，那只是你的个人偏见。

en: What I want to talk about is Lope.
u.src: 我想说的是啰培。

en: On the surface, Lope leads the Klax Party, but in reality the one manipulating Lope is the Pou-Fou Daily
u.src: 表面上啰培领导着喀拉克斯党，而实际上操纵啰培的是Pou-Fou日报

en: The word Pou-Fou is also an interjection with no real meaning.
u.src: （“卟—弗”一词也是个没有实际意义的感叹词。

en: If one insists on translating it, it can only be rendered as ah, and its president is Kuaikui.
u.src: 非要翻译出来，就只能翻译成“啊”）的社长哙哙。

en: But Kuaikui is not the real master either.
u.src: 但哙哙也不是真正的主人。

en: His master is Gaer, the one sitting right in front of you.
u.src: 他的主人就是坐在你面前的嘎尔。”

en: But... if I may speak frankly, isn't the Boo-Foo Daily supposed to be a newspaper that supports the workers?
u.src: “可是……恕我直言，《卟—弗日报》难道不是支持工人的报纸吗？

en: You say that Kuaikuai, the president of this newspaper, is also under your control, which means...
u.src: 你说这家报纸的社长哙哙也受你操纵，那不就是说……”

en: The reporters of the Pu-Fu Daily are undoubtedly supporting the workers.
u.src: “《卟—弗日报》的记者们无疑是支持工人的。

ja: ただクワックだけだった。
en: But the only one manipulating the reporters is Kwack.
u.src: 可是操纵记者们的，就只有哙哙了。

ja: そしてクワックはまた、
en: And Kwack in turn needs me, Gael, to act as his behind-the-scenes backer and support him.
u.src: 而哙哙又需要我嘎尔当后台老板来支援他。”

en: Gaar was still smiling as he toyed with the solid gold spoon.
u.src: 嘎尔依旧微笑地摆弄着纯金羹匙。

en: Looking at Gaar, I felt less hatred for him than pity for the reporters of the Pu-Fu Daily.
u.src: 我看着嘎尔的样子，与其说是憎恨他，不如说是同情《卟—弗日报》的记者们。

en: Seeing that I had fallen silent, Gar perhaps realized that I felt sympathy for him,
u.src: 嘎尔看到我默不出声，可能是意识到我心怀同情，

en: he thrust out his big belly with an air of triumph and said, "Well now, not all the reporters at the Poo-Foo Daily support the workers.
u.src: 趾高气扬提起大肚皮说：“嗐，《卟—弗日报》的记者们也不全都支持工人。

en: We kappas at least support ourselves first; everything else can step aside...
u.src: 我们河童至少优先支持我们自己，其他都靠边站呢……

en: What is still more troublesome is that there is even someone manipulating me, Gar.
u.src: 更麻烦的是，还有操纵我嘎尔的呢。

en: Who do you think that is?
u.src: 你觉得那是谁？

en: It is my wife, the beautiful and charming Mrs. Gar."
u.src: 那便是我的妻子——美丽迷人的嘎尔夫人。”
嘎尔开怀大笑。

en: In that case, it would be better to say you are happy.
u.src: “那不如说你很幸福吧。”
“反正我挺舒服的。

en: But I only speak this frankly in front of you, because you are not a kappa.
u.src: 但是我只有在你面前——因为你不是河童，才这么直接说实话的。”

en: So, the Karax cabinet is being controlled by Mrs. Gaal, then?
u.src: “这么说来，喀拉克斯内阁是由嘎尔夫人所操纵的喽？”

en: There is nothing wrong with putting it that way.
u.src: “这么说也没什么不对。

en: ...The war seven years ago really was caused by a certain female kappa.
u.src: ……七年前的战争确实是因为某只雌河童才引的。”

en: War? Does this country have wars too?
u.src: “战争？这个国家也有战争吗？”
“当然啦！

en: You never know when war might break out in the future.
u.src: 未来说不准什么时候就可能打起来呢。

en: As long as there are neighboring countries...
u.src: 只要有邻国……”

en: To tell the truth, it was only then that I learned that the kappa country was not a single independent nation either.
u.src: 说真的，我这时才了解到河童国也不是一个单独的国家。

en: According to Gael, the kappa regarded the otters as their imaginary enemy.
u.src: 根据嘎尔所说，河童把水獭当成假想敌。

en: Moreover, the otters' military equipment was by no means inferior to that of the kappa.
u.src: 而且水獭的军事装备并比河童差。

en: I became quite curious about the war between the kappa and the otters.
u.src: 我对河童和水獭之间的战争颇有好奇心。

en: Because it was a completely new discovery that the kappa's great rivals were otters,
u.src: （因为河童的劲敌是水獭是个全新发现，

ja: れられていないだけでなく、
en: not only was it never mentioned in Kappa Koryaku,
u.src: 不仅《河童考略》里没提过，

en: even Kunio Yanagita, the author of Yamashima Mintanshu, did not know it.)
u.src: 就连《山岛民谭集》的作者柳田国男也不知道呢。）

en: Before that war broke out, of course neither country dared let down its guard; each watched the other intently, and both were afraid of one another.
u.src: “那次战争爆发前，两国当然谁也不敢放松警惕，虎视眈眈地观察彼此，它们互相都有畏惧。

en: Later, an otter living in the land of the kappa went to visit a kappa couple.
u.src: 后来，一只居住在河童国的水獭去拜访一对河童夫妇。

en: The male kappa husband in the couple had no ambition, and the female kappa had originally planned to kill him.
u.src: 夫妻中的雄河童丈夫不思进取，雌河童原计划杀了丈夫。

en: Her husband had even bought life insurance, and for all we know, that may also have been part of the reason she murdered him.
u.src: 她丈夫还购买了寿险，搞不好在某种程度上这也是她谋杀亲夫的原因呢。”
“你和这对夫妇认识吗？”

en: Um, no, I only know the male one's husband.
u.src: “嗯——不，我只认得雄的丈夫。

en: My wife thinks that male is a villain,
u.src: 我老婆觉得那个雄的是坏蛋，

en: but to me he seems less a villain than a madman suffering from persecution mania,
u.src: 可我觉得与其说他是坏蛋，毋宁说他是患了被害妄想症的疯子，

en: afraid all day long that he would be caught by a female kappa...
u.src: 成天害怕被雌河童捉住……

en: Later, the female kappa put potassium cyanide in her husband's cola.
u.src: 后来，雌河童在老公的可乐里放了氰化钾。

en: Somehow, for reasons no one knows, she made a mistake,
u.src: 不晓得为什么搞错了，

en: and served it to an otter guest to drink.
u.src: 又把它拿给客人水獭喝了。

en: The otter promptly met his end.
u.src: 水獭这下呜呼哀哉了。
接着……”

en: Then did war break out between the two sides?
u.src: “接着双方就爆发了战争吗？”
“可不是嘛。

en: That otter had just happened to receive a medal before, too.
u.src: 那只水獭刚好以前又荣获过勋章。”
“谁赢了？”
“无疑是我们国家。

en: As a result, three hundred sixty-nine thousand five hundred kappa heroically sacrificed themselves for this cause.
u.src: 三十六万九千五百只河童因而，为此英勇牺牲了。

en: But compared with the enemy country, such a loss was insignificant.
u.src: 不过和敌国相比，这点损失就无所谓了。

en: The furs in our country are basically all otter pelts.
u.src: 我国的皮毛基本上都是水獭皮。

en: During the war, besides making glass, I also transported coal cinders to the battlefield.
u.src: 战争期间，除了制造玻璃，我还把煤渣运到战场上。”

en: What are you carrying coal cinders for?
u.src: “运煤渣做什么？”
“当然是吃喽。

en: We kappa can eat anything at all, as long as our bellies are hungry.
u.src: 我们河童只要肚皮饿了，什么都能吃的下去的。”
“这——请不要生气。

en: For the kappa on the battlefield, this... would count as a scandal even in our country.
u.src: 对于战场上的河童们，这……在我们国家也算丑闻呢。”

en: Of course, in this country this is a scandal too.
u.src: “当然，在这个国家这也是个丑闻。

en: But as long as the person concerned openly admits it, no one will treat it as a scandal anymore.
u.src: 但只要本人坦然承认，那么就没人会把它当成丑闻了。

en: The philosopher Magg once said, 'If one does not hide a fault, where is the fault in it?'
u.src: 哲学家马咯说过：‘错不讳言，何错之有。’

en: Besides, apart from making money, I am also full of patriotic fervor.
u.src: ……再说我除了赚钱之外，还有满腔的爱国热情呢。”

en: Just then, the club waiter happened to come in.
u.src: 此时，俱乐部的侍者正好走了进来。

en: He bowed to Geer to signal this, then said as if reciting: "The house next door to your residence is on fire."
u.src: 他对嘎尔鞠躬示意，像是朗诵一样的说：“您府邸的隔壁着火了。”

en: Garu stood up in a panic,
u.src: 嘎尔惊慌的站起来，

en: I also stood up with him.
u.src: 我也跟着站起来了。

en: Then the attendant calmly added another sentence: "But it has already been put out."
u.src: 然后侍者沉着地又补了一句：“不过已经扑灭了。”

en: Geeru watched the attendant's back recede into the distance, with an expression that was neither crying nor smiling.
u.src: 嘎尔目看着侍者的背影走远，神情半哭不笑的。

ja: ているうちに、いつからか、
en: As I looked at his face, I realized that at some point I had come to hate this glass company owner deeply.
u.src: 我看着他的脸，发现不知从何时起，我已经深深憎恨上这个玻璃公司老板了。

en: But the Geeru beside me now was not standing there as a great capitalist, but only as an ordinary kappa.
u.src: 可是现在的嘎尔并不是以大资本家的身份，而只是以一个普通河童的身份站在我身旁。

en: I took a winter rose from the vase and handed it to Geeru.
u.src: 我从花瓶里取出冬蔷薇递给嘎尔。

en: Although the fire has been put out, your wife must have had quite a fright, so please take these flowers home.
u.src: “火虽然被扑灭了，但您夫人难免会受到惊吓，你把这花带回去吧。”
“谢谢。”

en: Gael shook hands with me in farewell, then suddenly gave a little laugh and whispered to me,
u.src: 嘎尔和我握手告别，接着突然笑了一下，悄悄对我说，

en: The house next door is rented out to someone else, so at least I can still collect the fire insurance money.
u.src: “隔壁的房子我租给别人的，至少我还可以拿到火灾保险金。”

en: Even now I clearly remember Gael's smile from that time; it was a smile I could neither look down on nor hate.
u.src: 我到现在还清晰地记得那会儿嘎尔的微笑，是既不能蔑视，也不能憎恶的微笑。
